findings.title: Webhook retry may duplicate the charge
findings.invariant: one payment event creates at most one charge
findings.mechanism: retry processes the same event without an idempotency key

evidence.description: a lost response can cause the provider to retry

findings.title: Webhook replay inserts duplicate charge rows
findings.invariant: a payment event must create no more than one charge
findings.mechanism: the same event is processed again on retry with no idempotency key

evidence.description: handler inserts a charge before checking an event ledger

findings.title: Duplicate delivery creates two charges
findings.invariant: one payment event creates at most one charge
findings.mechanism: retry processes the same event without an idempotency key

evidence.description: post the same provider event id twice

findings.title: Webhook signature is never verified
findings.mechanism: handler parses the payload without validating its signature

evidence.description: handler never calls provider signature verification
